text: Election of the Chair for the Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for the appointed Term of Office ending October 24, 2022, and until a successor is elected.
The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Elected Johanna Braden as the Panel Chair for a term of office expiring October 24, 2022, and until a successor is elected.
